MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #19
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 156
   C. 24
   D. 144

2. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 2

3. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 400

4. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 90

5. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 19
   C. 17
   D. 23

6. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 10
   C. 25
   D. 26

7. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 9

8. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 170
   C. 26
   D. 169

9. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 42
   C. 24
   D. 12

10. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

11. Solve for x: x + 7 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 6
   C. 13
   D. 7

12. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 12
   C. 4
   D. 33

13. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 121
   C. 122
   D. 22

14. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 29
   C. 3
   D. 11

15. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 1
   C. 72
   D. 73

16. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 20
   C. 9
   D. 1

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
